fusions.name: Crack From Cover
fusions.desc: Fires a single shot that deals 32 damage and ignores the target's armour. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been hurt.

fusions.name: Report and Scatter
fusions.desc: A sudden bang deals 11 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Fire and Relocate
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and you scamper 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Bide for the Shot
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
